_comment: Brief de ejemplo con el schema expandido: sceneSeed compartido, narrativeBeat por slide, continuity entre slides, dataPoints citados y brandsReferenced para logo overlay. Este es el tipo de brief que content-forge-brief-architect produce tras invocar al researcher.
hook_line_1: El 63% de los DTC no pasa de los primeros 12 meses. Estos 3 errores explican casi todos los casos.
topic_summary: 3 errores comunes + 3 fixes prácticos sobre lanzamientos DTC en Latam, con datos Shopify 2025 y casos Duolingo y Allbirds.

sceneSeed.lightAngle: camera-left warm afternoon · rim light in #C27B3E
sceneSeed.lightIntensity: soft directional · crushed deep shadows · preserved highlights
sceneSeed.recurringProp: ceramic espresso cup on linen napkin
sceneSeed.mood: late afternoon editorial · boutique studio · quiet luxury
sceneSeed.cameraPreference: 35mm mid-shot · shallow DOF · film grain · -15% saturation
sceneSeed.wardrobeTone: neutral warm layered · linen and wool textures · matte tones
sceneSeed.backgroundFamily: textured off-white plaster walls · warm-toned wood accents

images.concept: Mid-shot of a founder at a small boutique desk late afternoon, warm directional light from camera-left casting a long shadow behind an espresso cup. She leans on a hand, thinking. Negative space at the top third for a large headline overlay.
images.composition: Top 32% empty. Subject anchored in the lower right rule-of-thirds cross.

continuity.connectsToNext: same desk, same light, camera pulls back to reveal the wider studio

images.characterHint: three-quarter turn toward camera, right hand on temple in a 'thinking' pose, looking slightly off-camera into a soft light source

images.concept: Wide editorial photo of the same boutique studio now seen from further back, the espresso cup visible on a wooden desk in the mid-ground, a chair slightly pushed out as if someone just left. Warm afternoon light still spilling through a window on camera-left.
images.composition: Centered horizontal composition, generous negative space above the cup for a data headline overlay.

continuity.connectsToPrevious: camera pulled back, same scene from slide 01 now reveals the wider space
continuity.connectsToNext: zoom into a detail of the desk — we'll see the notebook

dataPoints.claim: 63% de los DTC latam no supera los 12 meses

images.concept: Overhead flat lay of a worn linen-paper notebook open on the desk. Hand-drawn funnel sketch faded in pencil, a half-empty espresso cup at the edge, an unlabeled bottle of ink. Warm afternoon light from camera-left, the recurring espresso cup anchors the composition.
images.composition: Top-down 90°. Notebook dominates the lower half. Top 40% empty for eyebrow 'ERROR 01' + headline.

continuity.connectsToPrevious: zoom-in of the desk from slide 02 — the notebook was in the previous frame but not visible
continuity.connectsToNext: same desk, subject returns and writes in the notebook

images.concept: Mid-shot of the founder writing in the notebook from slide 03, the espresso cup present in the frame, soft smile as if she just cracked a thought. Same warm directional light from camera-left.
images.composition: Subject offset to the right third, notebook at the center, top-left 30% empty for eyebrow 'HAZLO ASÍ' + headline.

continuity.connectsToPrevious: subject is back at the desk we saw empty in 02 and zoomed into in 03
continuity.connectsToNext: she looks up from the notebook toward an unseen screen or audience

images.characterHint: seated, slight lean forward, pen in right hand, left hand resting on the notebook's open spine

dataPoints.claim: Pre-lanzamientos con pre-registro lograron 40k signups antes de abrir la tienda

images.concept: Quiet editorial close-up of the espresso cup now empty, the linen napkin folded neatly beside it, afternoon light fading. A soft brass outline of the logo-sized element on the plaster wall (no readable text). Wabi-sabi mood, end of the session.
images.composition: Square composition within the 4:5. Cup left-third, negative space right 2/3 for a closing line + logo in post-production.

continuity.connectsToPrevious: same light, same desk, the subject has left and only the trace of the scene remains
